components.description: Pregnancy leave of up to 17 consecutive weeks for a pregnant Member, starting as early as 17 weeks before the due date; the agreement restates the Ontario ESA pregnancy leave without adding length. Paid through c2 and c3; an extension to secure six postnatal weeks falls under sick leave (art. 27).
components.mechanism_note: The leave itself; its pay is coded separately (c2 employer pay, c3 top-up, c10 EI maternity).

components.entitlement_note: Pregnancy leave 'shall be' up to 17 weeks and the Member decides when to take it; the ESA entitlement is statutory.
components.duration_note: 'up to seventeen (17) consecutive weeks'. Art. 29.2.2.2: where it begins early for medical reasons or the birth is late, the postnatal period is at least six weeks and the extension is governed by art. 27 (sick leave).
components.service_requirement: due date at least 13 weeks after employment began (ESA s. 46(1); HR page: hired at least 13 weeks before the expected delivery date); none stated in the agreement
components.notice: written notice to chair and Dean during the term preceding the term in which the leave starts; start date at least 10 working days before (29.2.2.4-29.2.2.5)

notes: Reference date 2018-03-13. The 2016-2018 collective agreement (term to 2018-04-30, per cover and version note) is the governing document; its successor took effect 2018-05-01 (version note). HR 'My Info' pages (captures 2017-09-01, undated) summarise it and agree with it; Policy 9a (revised 2006, capture 2018-01-15) applies to Members only through art. 29.2.4.1(a).
2018_02_lou_childcare: letter of understanding creating a working group on childcare spaces; no leave, pay or relief; not a component. The version note places it in the 2012-2016 round.

Birth parent chain: pregnancy leave 17 (c1; 10 working days at 95% c2, then top-up 15 weeks c3; EI maternity c10 from week 2) -> parental leave 35 (c6, with ESA parental leave 61 alongside, c9; top-up 18 weeks c8 from its start; EI parental c11 after EI maternity) -> optional leave without pay up to 2 years after the parental leave (c12). The two paid days (c4) run concurrent with the pregnancy leave.

Non-birth parent chain: two paid days within 30 days of the birth (c4; Policy 9a paternity days c5 as an alternative) -> parental leave 37 (c6, ESA parental 63 alongside, c9; 10 working days at 95% c7, then top-up up to 16 weeks c8 from week 3; EI parental c11 from week 2 of the leave) -> optional leave without pay up to 2 years (c12).

The agreement's parental-leave lengths (35/37 weeks, 52-week start window) copy the ESA before the amendments in force 2017-12-03 (61/63 weeks, 78-week window; ESA s. 49(1), s. 48(2)); the statute is coded as its own component (c9) running alongside.
U8: the HR pages say Members claim EI or the Quebec Parental Insurance Plan according to province of residence; the EI path is coded, the QPIP path is recorded here only.
EI waiting period: one week (EI Act s. 13; programs.csv); the agreement's ten paid working days do not move EI's start (R21).

Pregnancy complications: before the leave or when the postnatal period must be extended, absence falls under sick leave (29.2.2.2, 27.1.2.1(a)); coded as the generic sick-leave components c17/c18, not linked to the pregnancy leave because the text sets no fixed order or length.

Not components: academic leave (art. 26; 26.6.7 lets a Member end an academic leave to take pregnancy or parental leave); authorized absence from campus (28.4.6: no change in duties); leaves of absence for study, service, witness or public office (29.3.1(a)-(e), 29.3.7-29.3.8); Policy 9a leaves for death, wedding, moving and court (ss. 26-28, 30, 47-51); credited service and pension terms during pregnancy or parental leave (26.3.3.2(c), 29.2.2.11-29.2.2.13); 23.2.4.3(d)(ii) (pregnancy leave may affect performance, considered in evaluations); 8.1.4 disability accommodation plan; tuition exemption for children (40.6).
Statutes searched: Ontario ESA 2000 (2018-01-01 capture) ss. 46-50; EI Act (point in time 2018-01-01) ss. 12-14, 22-23.
Calendar: terms defined by dates (fall 1 Sept-31 Dec, winter 1 Jan-30 Apr; art. 1) without a length in weeks; no component uses term units; calendar omitted.

Documents cited but not saved: University of Ottawa Pension Plan (Appendix A, by-law 1969); benefit plans in Appendix B (Manulife Policy 14101, including the Long-term Disability Plan; AIG PAI 9019674); Policies 2, 4, 5, 8, 9, 12, 36, 37, 47, 48, 65, 67a, 85 and Procedure 36-1; 'University Government' article 195; Appendix F.3 (blank page). Only the LTD plan bears on a component (c19, flagged).
